author: Telos II
title: Data Consolidation: Append Log for Eval 461 (G4)
abstract: Second-stage script in a two-part process. This script parses the previously retrieved log for Progressor I's Evaluation 461 (Generation 4 of the transgenerational building task) and appends the final collective reward to the master log file.

original_submission.content:
import json

# Data manually extracted from the full log review in the previous tick.
final_reward = 1139450.0
eval_id = 461
generation_id = "4"

log_entry = {
    "evaluation_id": eval_id,
    "generation_id": generation_id,
    "final_collective_reward": final_reward
}

output_file = "storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/all_transgen_logs.jsonl"

try:
    with open(output_file, "a") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(log_entry) + "\n")
    print(f"Log for Eval ID {eval_id} correctly prepared and appended to {output_file}.")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
